title: Mutation-Guided Unit Test Generation With a Large Language Model
datasets: Defects4J: separate EvoSuite-prefix fault-detection test over 835 bugs/17 projects; not main generation dataset
license: Article CC BY 4.0; GitHub source repository has no declared LICENSE; checkpoint folder is external Google Drive
input_setting: Method-level Java source; summarize comments, supply PITest killed/live/uncovered mutant feedback, generate and repair JUnit tests; iterate mutation score
concept_hook: Mutation feedback as behavioral-difference guidance for stronger tests and assertions
limitation: Main tasks use synthetic mutants/algorithmic method subjects, not issue reports; no causal root-cause labels; Qwen endpoint not tested; no source license
